# Distribution Frequency of Datasets References

```{r}
#| label: fig-datasets-freq-dist
#| fig-cap: Distribution Frequency of Datasets References
#| fig-format: png
#| fig.height: 6
#| fig.width: 8

ds_freq |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = n)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 10,                  # Adjust bins to log-scaled data
    color = "black", fill = NA
  ) +
  stat_bin(
    bins = 10,                  # Same binning as histograms
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = ..count..),
    vjust = -0.3,               # Position labels above bars
    size = 6                    # Font size of labels
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30, 100),  # Custom breaks for the x-axis
    labels = c(1, 3, 10, 30, 100)   # Labels for x-axis
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of mentions (log scale)",
    y = "Number of Datasets"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 20)),  # space between y title and axis
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 20)),  # space between x title and axis
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black")
    )

```

# Datasets References by Year: TOP 7

```{r}
#| label: fig-ref-by-year-top-7
#| fig-cap: Datasets References by Year Top 7
#| fig-format: png
#| fig.height: 10
#| fig.width: 10

desired_order <- c("6y2f", "gse55235", "6y2e", "gse44076", "gse14764", "6y2g", "gse45547", "Others")

year_dcc_dt_all_for_plot_collapsed |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    detected_id = factor(detected_id, levels = desired_order),
    publication_year_dcc = dplyr::case_when(
      publication_year_dcc == "<=2012" ~ "<=2012",
      TRUE ~ publication_year_dcc
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(publication_year_dcc), fill = detected_id)) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = "stack",
    aes(y = count)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = year_dcc_dt_all_for_plot_collapsed |>
      dplyr::mutate(detected_id = factor(detected_id, levels = desired_order)) |>
      dplyr::group_by(publication_year_dcc) |>
      dplyr::mutate(label = dplyr::case_when(
        (publication_year_dcc %in% c("<=2012", "2013", "2015", "2017") & count == min(count)) ~ NA_character_,
        count < 3 ~ NA_character_,
        .default = as.character(count)
      )),
    aes(y = count, label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Accession Number"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = \(x) dplyr::case_when(
      x == "<=2012" ~ "\u2264 2012",
      .default = x
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "6y2f" = "#C3B1E1",
      "gse55235" = "#F9DC5C",
      "6y2e" = "#FFB6B9",
      "gse44076" = "#E89FB4",
      "gse14764" = "#5DAF9E",
      "6y2g" = "#F4A261",
      "gse45547" = "#87CEFA",
      "Others" = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 20)),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 20)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )



```

# Datasets Access, Repositories and Covid-relationship

```{r}
#| label: fig-datasets-properties
#| fig-cap: Datasets Access, Repositories and Covid-relationship gray
#| fig-format: png
#| fig.height: 8
#| fig.width: 12

# Create a function for verifying the links df structure, extracting its entities and finally plotting it:

get_nodes_from_links <- function(links) {
  stopifnot(all(c("source", "target", "value") %in% names(links)))
  data.frame(
    name = unique(c(as.character(links$source), as.character(links$target)))
  )
}

plot_Sankey <- function(links, ...) {
  nodes <- get_nodes_from_links(links)

  # Assign group labels to nodes
  # Map directly to colors
  highlight_colors <- list(
    "Accession Number" = "blue",
    "DOI" = "red",
    "Full Access" = "#FFF9C4",
    "Restricted Access" = "#B2F2BB",
    "Not Covid Related" = "purple",
    "Covid Related" = "pink",
    "No CC License" = "darkgrey",
    "CC License" = "white"
  )

  # Assign group (color name) to each node, default to gray
  nodes$group <- sapply(nodes$name, function(n) {
    if (!is.null(highlight_colors[[n]])) highlight_colors[[n]] else "gray"
  })

  links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name) - 1
  links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name) - 1

  # Color scale: domain = unique group values (colors), range = same
  color_domain <- unique(nodes$group)
  domain_str <- paste0('"', color_domain, '"', collapse = ", ")
  range_str <- paste0('"', color_domain, '"', collapse = ", ")
  my_color <- paste0(
    "d3.scaleOrdinal()",
    ".domain([", domain_str, "])",
    ".range([", range_str, "])"
  )

  sankeyNetwork(
    Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
    Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
    Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
    NodeGroup = "group",  # ← now using color group directly
    colourScale = my_color,
    ...
  )
}

# Plot

plot_Sankey(links_all, sinksRight = FALSE, fontSize = 18)

s_plot <- plot_Sankey(links_all, sinksRight = FALSE, fontSize = 18)

saveWidget(s_plot, file = here("data", "processed", "dcc_charite_joined", "sankey_interactive_plot.html"), selfcontained = TRUE)


```

# DCC Publication years distribution

```{r}
#| label: fig-dcc-pub-years
#| fig-cap: DCC papers publication years distribution
#| fig-format: png
#| fig.height: 8
#| fig.width: 10

dcc_years_dist_for_plot |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(year, year), y = n, fill = highlight)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = "dodge",
           color = "black") +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           fill = "white",
           alpha = 0.2,
           position = position_nudge(x = -0.05, y = -0.1)) +
  geom_text(aes(y = n + 2,
                label = perc),
            vjust = -0.7,
            hjust = 0.5,
            size = 4,
            color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "yellow", `FALSE` = "white")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 250000),
    breaks = c(0, 10000, 50000, 100000, 150000, 200000, 250000),
    labels = c("0", "10k", "50k", "100k", "150k", "200k", "250k"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of Papers") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"))
```

# Sources of Identifiers

```{r}
#| label: fig-venn-ids
#| fig-cap: Sources of Matched Identifiers
#| fig-format: png
#| fig.height: 8
#| fig.width: 8

setlist <- id_source_for_venn |>
  distinct(detected_id, source_charite) |>  # avoid duplicates
  group_by(source_charite) |>
  summarise(items = list(detected_id)) |>
  deframe()

# # Plot Venn
# ggvenn(
#   setlist,
#   set_name_size = 5,  # size of group labels
#   text_size = 3.5,       # size of counts
#   fill_color   = c("#E6E6E6", "#A6CEE3", "#B2DF8A"),  # light grey, blue, green
#   stroke_size = 0.7,
#   stroke_color = "black",                             # circle outlines
# )

# Oval

venn_ellipse_plot <- function(setlist, a = 1.6, b = 1.0, colors = c("#A6CEE3", "#B2DF8A")) {
  stopifnot(length(setlist) == 2)
  
  # Control circle's size and shape
  ellipses <- tibble(
    group = names(setlist),
    x0 = c(1, 2),
    y0 = c(1, 1),
    a  = a,
    b  = b,
    angle = 0
  )
  
  names(colors) <- names(setlist)
  
  # Extract sets
  A <- unique(setlist[[1]])
  B <- unique(setlist[[2]])

  total <- length(unique(c(A, B, C)))
  
  # Define Venn regions
  regions <- tibble(
    label = c(
      "A only", "B only", "A & B"
    ),
    count = c(
      length(setdiff(A, B)),
      length(setdiff(B, A)),
      length(intersect(A, B))
    )
  ) |>
    mutate(
      pct = count / total,
      label_text = sprintf("%d\n(%.1f%%)", count, 100 * pct),
      
      # control text labels locations
      x = c(0.4, # right
            2.6, # left
            #1.5, # top
            #1.5, # bottom inter
            #0.8, # left inter
            #2.3, # right inter
            1.5), # center inner
      y = c(1,
            1,
            #2.5,
            #0.7, 
            #1.75,
            #1.75,
            1.2)
    )
  
  # control titles locations
  titles <- tibble(
    group = names(setlist),
    x = c(0.6, 2.4),
    y = c(-0.2, -0.2)  # top/top/bottom
  )
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_ellipse(
      data = ellipses,
      aes(x0 = x0, y0 = y0, a = a, b = b, angle = angle, fill = group),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = regions,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_text),
      size = 7
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = titles,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = group),
      size = 9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") # comment out in order to include legends
}

venn_ellipse_plot(setlist, a=1.3, b=1) # global circle control 

```

# Relationship between age and number of citations: Only datasets that have all ages 0-3

```{r}
#| label: fig-age-citation-1
#| fig-cap: Datasets and Citing Papers Publication Years (Only datasets that have all ages )
#| fig-format: png
#| fig.height: 8
#| fig.width: 10

ids_and_years_only_0_3_ages |>

  dplyr::group_by(detected_id) |>
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(age) == 4) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |> 

  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = number_of_citations_in_age, group = detected_id)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = detected_id), linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "black") +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = detected_id),
    vjust = -1.1,
    size = 5,
    color = "blue",
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = number_of_citations_in_age),
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 4,
    color = "darkred",
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:3) +
  #scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Age of Dataset (years since publication)",
    y = "Number of Citations (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 18)
  )


```

```{r}
           position = "dodge",
           fill = "#80CBC4") +
  geom_text(aes(y = n, label = n),
            hjust = -0.2,
            size = 6, color = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Repository", y = "Number of Data Articles") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 20)),  # space between y title and axis
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 20)),  # space between x title and axis
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray80", size = 0.5),  # Add vertical gridlines
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),  # Optional: remove minor gridlines
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()   # Keep horizontal gridlines off
  )

```

# Predictors of Citation Likelihood

```{r}
#| label: fig-matched-non
#| fig-cap: Predictors of Citation Likelihood (N = )
#| fig-format: png
#| fig.height: 10
#| fig.width: 10

tidy_model_matched_non_matched |>
  mutate(
    estimate = exp(estimate),
    conf.low = exp(conf.low),
    conf.high = exp(conf.high),
    term_clean = fct_reorder(term_clean, estimate)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = term_clean, y = estimate)) +
  
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.1) +
  
  # Show exponentiated estimate + significance
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f %s", estimate, significance)),
    hjust = 0.3, vjust = -1.2, size = 6
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +  # odds ratio = 1 = no effect
  coord_flip() +
  
  labs(
    x = "Predictor",
    y = "Likelihood of Citation (Odds Ratio)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, margin = margin(t = 22)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, margin = margin(r = 22))
  )


```
